tagline: Rounded bolsters to settle against, in a teal songbird print worth keeping in view.
lead: Your dog gets cushioned, rounded sides to settle against, in a teal songbird print you won't want to hide.
value: Everyday pattern, not precious fabric: the zipped cover comes off and washes at 30°C, so the print can stay out in the room.
intro: Nightingale is a bolster dog bed in teal fabric with a songbird print, rounded bolster sides and a cushioned resting space. The zipped cover washes at 30°C. Medium and Large.
points: A distinctive finish that still lets the room feel like yours.
Rounded bolsters frame the cushioned sleeping area.
Choose around the usable space your dog needs inside the bolsters.
best_for: Dogs who like cushioned bolster sides, in homes that welcome a patterned finish.
fit_note: Ask us for exact measurements before choosing. Measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, add 15–20cm, and compare that with the usable space inside the bolsters, not the outside footprint.
care: Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label, then let it air-dry fully before it goes back on.
seo_title: Teal Songbird Print Bolster Dog Bed | Snoozly
seo_description: Rounded bolsters to lean on, in a teal songbird print that stays on show. Patterned bolster dog bed, cushioned base, 30°C washable cover. Medium & Large.
